decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel got its own page in 2019, which suggests it survived the early pruning of the 2018 launches, and keeping a staple cheese in an established range costs little while its value is still being proven.

The spicy cheese passed the first screening and was promoted to its own page, but flavored variants carry more market uncertainty, as the dropped onion-and-pepper cheese showed, so its option is kept open at moderate risk.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounded out the new range and was featured on its own page in 2019, and with low holding costs and no negative signal it remains a cheap option worth keeping.
